cohort: The study included 98 women undergoing caesarean section in Nigeria.
finding: Placental delivery from non-exteriorized uterus during caesarean section showed a statistically significant higher likelihood of blood loss of 500ml or more compared to exteriorized placenta removal.
mod_finding: Placental delivery from non-exteriorized uterus during caesarean section was associated with a statistically significant higher likelihood of blood loss of 500ml or more compared to exteriorized placenta removal.
